findings.claim: The switcher wiring was NOT missing - it already exists and is correct. Pill click (synapse_panel.py:1015) -> _select_profile (:499) persists via SwitcherState + sets _layout_profile (:518) + _recompose (:520) -> compositor.compose(self, root, get_manifest(profile)) (:566). The gap the seat-walk exposed is that this live half was delegated to a manual seat accept (test_rope_switcher_state.py docstring L4-6) and never machine-observed, so a contradiction (code says wired, seat says dead) sat unresolved. This leg resolves it: the wiring works; the perceived failure is a rendering bug (next finding).

ROOT CAUSE of the live-seat 'does nothing': compositor._repolish_tree is dead. (a) It does 'from qtpy import QtWidgets' - qtpy is not installed in this env, so it returns early and repolishes nothing. (b) Even with qtpy present, the 'break' after the first stack.extend pops only the root and never repolishes the descendants it just queued. Every density QSS rule is a descendant selector (#DsRoot[density=...] QPushButton#DsButton etc.), so density never reaches child widgets and airy/standard/tight render identically - the strongest visible switch lever is inert. The compositor comment at :222-226 claims this bug was already fixed; it was not. Separate rendering defect, headless-unverifiable (no Qt here), NOT switcher wiring - filed as spawn W5-ROPE-DENSITY-REPAINT.

Secondary defect (context for the spawn): compositor._apply_spec applies 'collapsed' one-way (setMaximumHeight(0) only, never restored), so curious's folded readouts (token_meter/activity_meter) never un-collapse when switching back to expert/ml. Moot at the seat today because those widgets are already invisible (activity_meter setVisible(False) at build; token_meter has no text writer), but it is a real asymmetry a density fix should address alongside.

spawn.name: fix compositor._repolish_tree so profile density (airy/standard/tight) visibly re-applies on switch
spawn.note: Root cause of the 2026-08-16 seat-walk 'switcher does nothing'. The wiring works (W5-ROPE proved it) but _repolish_tree is dead: it imports qtpy (uninstalled -> early return) and, even with qtpy, breaks after popping only the root so density QSS descendant rules never reach children. Fix: use the panel's own Qt binding (mirror synapse_panel.py:15-23 try PySide6 except PySide2) instead of qtpy, and drop the premature break so findChildren(QWidget) descendants all repolish. Also make _apply_spec 'collapsed'/'visible' two-way so a switch-back restores (see finding 3). Verifiable at logic level headless (traversal reaches every node; no qtpy dep); final Qt repaint stays seat-verified. Held for Joe: class 'build' is outside W5-ROPE spawn_classes ['probe'].
